manifest.source: GENERATED by packages/surface/vendors/codex/census/generate-model.mjs. Shapes are the vendor's own `codex app-server generate-json-schema` output; confidence is from the hermetic census in packages/surface/vendors/codex/census/harness.mjs (packages/surface/vendors/codex/findings.md C1d). Never hand-edit: regenerate.

argv.notes: The adapter launches `codex app-server` and configures it with repeated `-c key=value`. There is no session id at spawn: the thread id arrives on thread/started (C0 §3).

appserver.notes: NDJSON over stdio, JSON-RPC-2.0-SHAPED but not conformant: `jsonrpc` is omitted on server output and merely tolerated on input, and the generated JSONRPCRequest requires only id+method. A strict JSON-RPC library will not work unmodified (C1b finding 5).

terminal.notes: The native ratatui TUI, attached over `--remote` (C0 §8). Semantics are never derived from it (ADR-003); it exists so a human can watch.

limitations: Artifact integrity and the hermetic census are pinned for darwin-arm64; other platform artifacts still require independent acquisition and verification.

behavior.title: Codex app-server native protocol lifecycle
behavior.description: Observable app-server methods and payload-discriminated item lifecycles for codex-cli 0.147.0. Repeated item/started and item/completed nodes are distinguished by native item.type, not normalized categories. Node confidence applies to the event plus selector claim, not merely to the shared method name.
behavior.source: Vendor-generated experimental app-server schema plus the hermetic C1 census in packages/surface/vendors/codex/findings.md.

nodes.description: May repeat asynchronously throughout a turn; not a single exclusive lifecycle node.
